name: soroban-merkle-airdrop
description: Gas-efficient Merkle tree airdrop for Stellar. Stores only a 32-byte Merkle root on-chain; recipients prove inclusion via compact Merkle proofs.

functions.name: initialize
functions.description: Initialise the airdrop. Must be called once before any claims. The caller deposits total_amount tokens from the SEP-41 token contract into this contract. Emits an 'init' event.

inputs.name: admin
inputs.description: Address that controls the airdrop (can pause and reclaim).

inputs.name: token
inputs.description: SEP-41 token contract address to distribute.

inputs.name: merkle_root
inputs.description: 32-byte Merkle root of the (address, amount) distribution tree.

inputs.name: total_amount
inputs.description: Total tokens to distribute; transferred from admin into the contract.

inputs.name: expiration
inputs.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) after which reclaim() is permitted.

output.description: Ok(()) on success, or an AirdropError on failure.

functions.name: claim
functions.description: Claim tokens from the airdrop. The claimant provides their allocation amount and a Merkle proof demonstrating they are in the distribution tree. Tokens are transferred immediately on success. Emits a 'claimed' event.

inputs.name: claimant
inputs.description: Address claiming tokens; must sign the transaction (require_auth).

inputs.name: amount
inputs.description: Token amount allocated to this claimant.

inputs.name: proof
inputs.description: Ordered list of sibling hashes from leaf to root.

output.description: Ok(()) on success, or an AirdropError on failure.

functions.name: set_active
functions.description: Pause or unpause the airdrop. Only the admin can call this.

inputs.name: active
inputs.description: true to activate, false to pause the airdrop.

output.description: Ok(()) on success, or an AirdropError on failure.

functions.name: reclaim
functions.description: Reclaim unclaimed tokens after the airdrop expires. Admin only. Can only be called once env.ledger().timestamp() >= expiration. Transfers the contract's remaining token balance back to the admin. Emits a 'reclaimed' event.

output.description: The amount reclaimed (i128) on success, or an AirdropError on failure.

functions.name: merkle_root
functions.description: Return the Merkle root stored in this contract. Returns None if not yet initialised.

functions.name: is_claimed
functions.description: Return true if the given claimant address has already claimed.

output.description: true if the address has claimed, false otherwise.

functions.name: is_active
functions.description: Return whether the airdrop is currently active.

output.description: true if the airdrop is active, false if paused or uninitialised.

functions.name: token
functions.description: Return the SEP-41 token contract address being distributed.

output.description: Token contract address, or None if not yet initialised.
Admin address, or None if not yet initialised.

functions.name: total_deposited
functions.description: Return total tokens deposited at initialisation.

output.description: Total tokens deposited (0 if not yet initialised).

functions.name: expiration
functions.description: Return the expiration timestamp (unix seconds) after which reclaim is allowed.

output.description: Expiration unix timestamp, or None if not yet initialised.

errors.name: AlreadyInitialized
errors.description: Contract has already been initialised. initialize() may only be called once.

errors.name: AlreadyClaimed
errors.description: Caller has already claimed their allocation. Each address may only claim once.

errors.name: InvalidProof
errors.description: The Merkle proof supplied does not verify against the stored root. Check the proof and amount are correct.

errors.name: NotActive
errors.description: Contract is not currently active. The admin has paused the airdrop.

errors.name: NotInitialized
errors.description: Contract has not been initialised yet. Call initialize() first.

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.description: Zero or negative amount is not valid for initialize() or claim().

errors.name: NotYetExpired
errors.description: reclaim() called before the expiration timestamp has been reached.

instance.description: 32-byte Merkle root of the distribution tree.
Unix timestamp after which reclaim is permitted.

persistent.description: Whether a given claimant address has claimed. TTL ~2 years.

steps: 1. Encode the Stellar address as its strkey UTF-8 string bytes (e.g. 'GABC...' for G-accounts, 'CABC...' for contracts).
2. SHA-256 hash those bytes to produce a stable 32-byte address digest.
3. Encode the token amount as a 16-byte big-endian integer.
4. Concatenate (address_digest ++ amount_bytes) and SHA-256 hash to produce the 32-byte leaf.

node_hash_algorithm.description: SHA-256(min(left, right) ++ max(left, right)) — children are sorted so the tree is position-independent.
node_hash_algorithm.note: Sorting by byte value means the same distribution produces the same root regardless of input list order.
